body.x: POLAR(www.polar.com), the leader in heart rate, fitness and sport technologies, introduced wearable sports watch series including 'V800' and 'A300' at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Polar V800 is a GPS sports watch for professional and devoted athletes who want high-performing watches. It provides smart and advanced services for many different sports and athletic endeavors. It features an integrated GPS and 24/7 activity tracking with customizable multi-sport profiles. Compatible with Polar Flow, a free web service and app that goes with the watch, users can monitor workout training load and all activity data to determine accurate recovery time.Polar A300 is designed as a fitness watch with a goal to lead users to new era of fitness trackers. In addition to heart-rate based Polar Smart Coaching Features, the A300 also includes daily activity tracking and records steps, calories burned, sleep and active time.Through Bluetooth smart technology, the A300 communicates with the Polar Flow app and updates its software as needed, making the unit future-proof.The Flow web service and app provide information on the fitness and health benefits of your daily activity choices. Heart-rate based training guidance informs training practices to improve your fitness levels.Changeable wrist straps with three exciting colors(black, white and coral pink) make the A300 ideal for everyday use.
